decision.next_hypothesis: H014-SUB-007: retaining the two shared experts at the parent avoids an additional expert-output collective and is superior to remote or replicated placement once real shared-expert compute, tensor residency and measured fine-edge transport are included.

hypothesis.prediction: One worker-level activation upload, device gather, grouped expert execution and one output download preserve exact batches 1/2/4/8, improve batch-8 complete-layer capacity >=1.20x versus H014-SUB-006c, retain >=80% resident throughput and do not increase tensor payload or messages.

inspection.actual_bottleneck: At batch 8 the complete layer is 17.4095 ms p50 and the external phase is 9.0802 ms. The collective is 7.1793 ms: critical input+device-gather+expert compute is 5.630304 ms, exposed loopback/coordination is 1.17785 ms, H2D enqueue wall is 0.1305 ms and output D2H wall is 0.11145 ms. Tensor payload is 286,720 bytes/row and routing is imbalanced: across the three correctness routes worker totals are 105/107/78/94 selections, hottest/coldest 1.3718x. Grouped expert compute and route-dependent critical-worker load now dominate; synchronization removal is no longer the leading local mechanism.
inspection.fixture_limitation: Three retained real boundaries are row-rotated; route overlap is real for this trace but not a production prompt distribution.
